usage.help.title: Usage and tokens
usage.help.intro: Usage brings together consumption found in local transcripts and the limits reported by the plans. It helps you understand the pace, models, and projects concentrating the activity.
usage.help.first.title: First steps
usage.help.first.step1: Tap today in the left sidebar footer to open Usage.
usage.help.first.step2: At the top, review how much remains in each plan window and when it resets.
usage.help.first.step3: Choose Day, Week, or Month, then filter by project.
usage.help.first.step4: Switch between $ and tok to read General and Trend with the same metric.
usage.help.first.step5: Tap the Trend chart if you need an enlarged view.

usage.help.buttons.title: Buttons and actions
usage.help.buttons.today.v: Opens the modal and shows the day's total local tokens in the footer.
usage.help.buttons.reload.v: Re-reads transcripts and limits immediately; it does not start an AI runner or consume tokens.
usage.help.buttons.connect.v: Appears when the current credential can't read Anthropic's usage meter. Opens account authorization so Usage can show actual plan percentages; the process doesn't consume tokens.
usage.help.buttons.range.v: Changes the period for General and Trend: today by hour, the last 7 days, or the last 30 days.
usage.help.buttons.project.v: Filters local usage by project; plan limits always remain account-wide.
usage.help.buttons.cost.v: Shows the API-price equivalent cost and orders models by rate.
usage.help.buttons.tokens.v: Shows the token volume recorded in transcripts.
usage.help.buttons.credits.v: Expands the extra credit detail, if the plan reports it.
usage.help.buttons.chart.v: Opens a large copy of the chart with the current range, project, and metric.
usage.help.buttons.note: All these actions only retrieve, filter, or display data: they don't run AI or consume tokens.
usage.help.history.title: Persistent history
usage.help.history.text: Day is built from the available transcripts. Week and Month use usage-history.json, which survives CLI transcript pruning and powers the Trend charts.
usage.help.warning.title: Watch out for this
usage.help.warning.text: The displayed COST is an API-price equivalent, NOT an actual subscription charge. Everything is grouped in Medellín local time. Each cache read is weighted ×0.1 versus a normal token: NEVER compare raw token counts with each other; the honest metric is equivalent cost. Codex appears when local data or limits are available, but without a verified public rate it shows “no rate” and does not add to the dollar total.
